F1: add_members` pushes each user via `Group#add` with no membership check or rescue, so an existing member hits the unique `(group_id, user_id)` index, raises a 500, and leaves earlier names added.
F2: group.users.delete(user_id)` bulk-deletes the join row in Rails 4.1.8, so the `user_count` counter cache is not decremented and `primary_group_id` is never cleared on this path.
F3: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` reports 2 pages for 50 members, so `showingLast` is false on the real last page and "next" moves to offset 50, an empty page.
F4: findMembers` clamps against the pre-removal `user_count`, so removing the 51st member re-requests offset 50 and leaves an empty page 2 with no automatic step back.
F5: the public members route calls `findMembers()` with offset 0 and limit 50, and `group/members.hbs` has no pager or load-more, so members past the first 50 cannot be seen.
F6: members` passes `params[:limit].to_i` and `params[:offset].to_i` straight into `.limit/.offset` with no clamping, so negative values produce a PostgreSQL error (500) and limit is uncapped.
F7: the `addMembers` and `removeMember` actions and their model methods chain only success handlers, so 422/404/500 responses give the admin no feedback, and `usernames` is not cleared after a successful add.
F8: the `create` action sets only `name` and `visible` while the JS posts `alias_level` and the new-group form offers the selector, so the chosen alias level is discarded.
